title: CardRetracted
description: Payload: a card left the live list (S9). Also explicit (INV-21): it carries the card as it was and the events that withdrew it. A retracted card is not revived; a later card gets a new cardId.

reason.description: 'track-lost': its spine is gone. 'evidence-withdrawn': what supported it no longer does. 'superseded': another card replaces it. 'dismissed': the owner removed it.

last.description: What it was when it left; the ledger checks it is the card's current state.

reasonEventSeqs.description: Ledger positions of the events that withdrew it.
